get.description:
Returns all Weather Logs for the current date.

See [Working with Daily Logs](https://developers.procore.com/documentation/daily-logs) for information on filtering the response using the log\_date, start\_date, and end\_date parameters. Note that if none of the date parameters are provided in the call, only logs from the current date are returned.

parameters.name: log_date
parameters.description: Date of specific logs desired. Example formats YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY/MM/DD, DD-MM-YYYY, DD/MM/YYYY

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Start date of specific logs desired. Use together with end_date to specify a date range. Example formats YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY/MM/DD, DD-MM-YYYY, DD/MM/YYYY

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: End date of specific logs desired. Use together with start_date to specify a date range. Example formats YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY/MM/DD, DD-MM-YYYY, DD/MM/YYYY

parameters.name: filters[status]
parameters.description: Filter on log status

parameters.name: filters[created_by_id]
parameters.description: Returns item(s) created by the specified User IDs.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Elements per page

parameters.name: filters[daily_log_segment_id]
parameters.description: Daily Log Segment ID filter

ground.description: Translated Ground condition based on user's locale. List of possible values can be retrieved using Weather Conditions API https://developers.procore.com/reference/rest/v1/weather-conditions?version=1.0

updated_at.description: Timestamp of last update to Location

temperature.description: Translated Temperature condition based on user's locale. List of possible values can be retrieved using Weather Conditions API https://developers.procore.com/reference/rest/v1/weather-conditions?version=1.0

time.description: UTC time weather conditions were observed

wind.description: Translated Wind condition based on user's locale. List of possible values can be retrieved using Weather Conditions API https://developers.procore.com/reference/rest/v1/weather-conditions?version=1.0
